common.style_usage: Stardew Valley portrait style and FRAMING exactly like this portrait: large head filling most of the frame, shoulders cut off at the bottom; saturated hue-shifted cel shading, dark coloured (not black) outlines, about 30 colours
common.reference_usage: this exact character in this exact pose and framing: the same hair, bun, pencil, loupe and band, blouse, apron and head position; keep everything identical and change ONLY the facial expression

happy.description: Stardew Valley portrait of Margot Pell, a museum painting conservator in her early thirties: freckled light skin, warm brown eyes, dark auburn hair pinned up in a messy bun with a yellow pencil through it, a brass jeweller's loupe on a green band pushed up on her forehead, cream collared blouse, sage green apron. Same pose and framing as the reference, three-quarter view. Expression: a big warm delighted smile, eyes bright, cheeks lifted
